title: Embedded OLE object odt 001
notes: legacy OLE embed in ODF: real binary part object.bin (hand-built minimal CFB v3 stub, imported _ole_cfb_stub from the docx builders) with manifest media-type application/x-ole-object, referenced by draw:frame (as-char anchor, svg 5cm x 5cm, draw:opacity="100%") > draw:object (draw:mime-type + draw:object-type "application/oleobject", xlink:type simple, xlink:href object.bin, show=embed, actuate=onLoad). Honest caveat: the CFB stub carries no real payload/streams, so LibreOffice may show an icon placeholder or render nothing for the object — reference text covers only the three surrounding text paragraphs.
